text: {"side": "artifact", "claims": [{"text": "Emulsion effects are the most common known issue in this packet: 62 of 1188 trigger points are flagged as non-blue emulsion, so a plate-emulsion response change could contribute to the apparent dip.", "evidence_ids": ["E-058"]}, {"text": "Two points carry an unknown-emulsion tag, including the deepest dip at 1934.331 with an offset of -2.613 mag, which is a single-plate excursion whose emulsion response is unverified.", "evidence_ids": ["E-059", "E-047"]}, {"text": "Shape outliers are widespread, with 241 of 1188 points flagged, and several of the listed dips (1939.287 at -1.445 mag, 1950.85 at -1.312 mag) carry the SHAPE_OUTLIER tag, suggesting the low points may reflect plate-specific image quality rather than the star.", "evidence_ids": ["E-062", "E-050", "E-055"]}, {"text": "Plate-edge flags affect 39 points, and the listed point at 1943.022 is tagged both SHAPE_OUTLIER and PLATE_EDGE, so edge effects on the plate could be affecting some of the measurements.", "evidence_ids": ["E-063", "E-051"]}, {"text": "The series-zero-point evidence shows the ac series near zero (-0.008 over 528 points), but the series a, b, and dnb zero points are offset, and the event spans the 1900 to 1952 epochs across several series boundaries, so a seam between plate series is possible; the packet does not show the per-series alignment for the dip epochs.", "evidence_ids": ["E-016", "E-015", "E-020", "E-024", "E-002"]}]}
